설계메모: 실험실 보유 여부 확인. 모터 부하에 맞춰 전류 용량 선정.

design_notes_en: Check lab availability; choose current capacity for motor load.
budget_notes_en: Assumed borrowed and excluded from baseline request.

design_notes_en: No extra adapter if controller USB is usable.
budget_notes_en: USB-C data cable for OpenRB-150; separate U2D2 not required in baseline.

budget_notes_en: B6neo KRW 58,000 + 45W PD supply/cable 17,600 + XT60-to-XT30, balance connections and storage bag allowance 15,000.

설계메모: 한쪽 다리 하중 시험. 모터는 본체용 10개 중 재사용.

design_notes_en: One-leg load testing; reuse motors from the ten body motors.
budget_notes_en: Allowance for clamps, weights and fixture material; motors reused.

design_notes_en: No new purchase if existing equipment is available.
budget_notes_en: Assumed borrowed and excluded from baseline request.

설계메모: 반복 동작 시 표면 온도와 모터 피드백 비교.
산정메모: 온도 측정 장비. 대여 가정으로 기본 요청액 제외.
design_notes_en: Compare surface temperature with motor feedback during repeated motion.
budget_notes_en: Assumed borrowed and excluded from baseline request.

설계메모: 초기 기립 시험. 로봇 질량에 포함하지 않음.

design_notes_en: Initial standing tests; not part of robot mass.
budget_notes_en: Frame, tether and mounts. Trials where the tether bears weight do not count as independent walking.

design_notes_en: Separate from the ten/twelve motors mounted on the robot.
budget_notes_en: One optional spare beyond the ten baseline motors.
